svg.title: ROVER recursive reasoning over videos — editable reconstruction
svg.desc: Three levels of recursive task decomposition. All text, panels, time labels, connectors, and symbols are editable vector objects. Nine original robot scenes are individually embedded raster images.

text.tspan: Task: “Thaw the steak in the microwave”
The gripper is in front of microwave...
The robot opened the microwave door.
The robot put the steak in the microwave.
The gripper is in front of microwave...
The robot fully grasped the door handle.
The robot opened the microwave door.
The gripper is in front of microwave...
The gripper moved closer to the door...
The robot fully grasped the door...
